item.description:
Gomez, A., Han, S., Lozano, L.
We consider mixed-integer quadratic optimization problems with banded matrices and indicator variables. These problems arise pervasively in statistical inference problems with time-series data, where the banded matrix captures the temporal relationship of the underlying process. item.description:
Loke, G., Zhu, T., Zuo, R.

item.title: EXPRESS: When Good Practices Go Too Far: Overshooting in Organizational Culture
item.description:
Brahm, F., Loch, C., Poblete, J.
Business research has examined how useful practices can be made to spread and develop in organizations. However, practices have been observed “overshooting”: either over-diffusing—too many employees adopt them, including some whose usage is unproductive; or becoming over-sophisticated—the practice becomes too elaborate, reducing organizational performance. item.description:
Jeff Toorongian, Amy Blake
Creating accessible documents is easier when accessibility is considered from the start. This 45-minute session will introduce practical strategies for creating documents that are structured and formatted with accessibility in mind. We’ll review several foundational practices, including the effective use of headings, lists, meaningful links, alternative text for images, tables, and color and contrast.
